methods.name: RAVE
methods.description: Audio representation learning model able to model both monophonic and polyphonic signals, trained in two stages.

methods.name: unsupervised NSynth
methods.description: Baseline model evaluated using official implementation with default parameters.

methods.name: SING
methods.description: Autoencoder baseline model evaluated using official implementation with default parameters.

methods.name: data augmentation strategy
methods.description: Uses dequantization, random crop, and allpass filters with random coefficients.

methods.name: RAVE (Realtime Audio Variational autoEncoder)
methods.description: A variational autoencoder built for high-quality audio representation learning and faster than realtime synthesis targeting 48kHz audio signals.

methods.name: Multiband decomposition
methods.description: Decomposition of raw waveform into 16 bands to decrease temporal dimensionality and expand temporal receptive field without major computational complexity increase.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Combination of a multiband decomposition followed by a simple convolutional neural network, transforming the raw waveform into a 128-dimensional latent representation.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Modified version of the generator proposed by Kumar et al. (2019) using an alternation of upsampling layers and residual networks.

methods.name: NSynth
methods.description: audio modelling method used with audio downsampled to 16kHz

methods.name: generator
methods.description: Modified version of the generator proposed by Kumar et al. (2019) using an alternation of upsampling layers and residual networks, feeding the last hidden layer to three sub-networks: waveform synthesizer, loudness envelope generator, and noise synthesizer.

methods.name: waveform sub-network
methods.description: Synthesizes a multiband audio signal with tanh activation.

methods.name: loudness sub-network
methods.description: Generates an amplitude envelope with sigmoid activation to multiply with the waveform output.

methods.name: noise synthesizer
methods.description: Synthesizer proposed in Engel et al. (2019) producing multiband filtered noise added to the signal.

methods.name: discriminator
methods.description: Strided convolutional network applied on different scales of the audio signal to prevent artifacts, as in Kumar et al. (2019).

methods.name: feature matching loss
methods.description: Feature matching loss used as in Kumar et al. (2019).
